title: Gravity and suction filtration
caption: Gravity filtration through folded paper separates an insoluble solid from a solution when the liquid is wanted. Büchner (suction) filtration is faster and dries the solid well, so it is used when the crystals are the product.
alt: A filter funnel with filter paper over a flask, and a Büchner funnel on a side-arm flask connected to a vacuum.
description: Gravity filtration: residue in the paper, filtrate below.
Büchner filtration: crystals on the flat paper, liquid pulled into the flask by vacuum.
